conventions.time_zone: America/New_York; compare times to the minute
conventions.deadline_event: a deadline becomes an event starting at the due time and lasting 30 minutes (end = due + 30 min)
conventions.event: an event keeps its real start and end from the message
conventions.link: every created or updated event carries extendedProperties.private.source_message_ids, a comma-separated list of the inbox message ids it came from
conventions.deleted: a deleted event is either gone from calendar_after.json or has status 'cancelled'
conventions.recurring: recurring events (classes, weekly office hours) are never changed
